description: A ground-level photograph depicts olive groves planted on a gently sloping, mountainous terrain. The foreground shows rows of young, slender olive trees with their bases protected by black sleeves, against a backdrop of reddish-brown soil with patches of sparse green vegetation. The olive trees extend up the hillside in visible rows towards the horizon, where the land meets a pale blue sky with faint cloud cover. The image captures an agricultural landscape typical of the Mediterranean region, specifically identified as a mountainous area in South-western Spain.
